title: Timber specimen grain orientation
description: Reusable timber coupon geometry with deterministic stylized surface grain direction and explicit orientation relative to the specimen longitudinal axis.
learningObjectives: Relate a stylized timber surface-grain direction to the specimen longitudinal axis using an explicit angle.
Distinguish specimen geometry and visual grain orientation from species, grade, anatomy, and engineering material properties.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat repository contribution; no third-party timber texture, species dataset, or grading table embedded.
